description:
This build order inspired by Vortix's Rush+Fast Castle Build Order but it has been changed to make it easier for beginners (therfore it is easier to follow but most likely worse than the original build). 
The main difference is that we go on barry as soon as Tawara upgrade is done, we do this to preserve sheep for a safe food source vs raiding civs. 

Heads up: The timings might be off in the game based on walking distances of the Vills (Villagers) to the resources and etc.
name: Beginner Friendly Vortix Spear + Fast Castle
author: taktaktab

notes: 1 Vill builds @building_military/barracks.webp@ , 2 Vills to @resource/sheep.webp@, 2 Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Builld a @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ next to the @resource/berrybush.webp@ with the @building_military/barracks.webp@ Builder vill once @building_military/barracks.webp@ is done.
Produce 2@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ from @building_military/barracks.webp@ (could go for 3@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ if needed*)

once we have 75 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ we get @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@ and move one @resource/resource_wood.webp@ vill to build @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ by the @resource/resource_gold.webp@
once @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ is done send the builder Vill to@resource/resource_gold.webp@  and move 2 vills from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
once @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@ is done send all all sheep vills to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Once we have 50 move @resource/resource_wood.webp@ move the @resource/resource_wood.webp@ Vill to build another @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ next to @resource/berrybush.webp@
after finishiing the @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ the vill will go onto @resource/berrybush.webp@
Use 2 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills to age up with @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ on the woodline
Movev 2 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for a totall of 5

Note: Try to save your 2-3 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend vs any cav that tries to harras your @resource/resource_gold.webp@. if this is not possible then invest 1-2 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ Vills into @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to make either a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ or more @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ based on what the opponent is building.
(The rest of this guide assumes that we did not need to move any Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@)*
Once @resource/berrybush.webp@ is done, move the @resource/berrybush.webp@ Vills to @resource/sheep.webp@
Once @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ is done, move the 2 builder Vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Age up with 8 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills and build @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@
(We Need 200  @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for a @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ and then a @building_military/stable.webp@)
Once aged up,  5 @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ builder vills builld @building_military/stable.webp@ and then they go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Note: Continue to move @resource/sheep.webp@Vills to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@ when they become available

Once @building_military/stable.webp@ is done, put @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@ in @building_military/stable.webp@ and make @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@/@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

Grab @resource/relics.webp@ and if opponent is passive (you have map controll) get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and raid with @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@/@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@
Continue the rest of the game and make sure to macro based on your needs:

sau khi được 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ chuyển 5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ăn @resource/resource_stone.webp@ sang ăn @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ cạnh  @building_economy/town-center.webp@

5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ăn @resource/sheep.webp@ chuyển sang @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ còn lại @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ chừa 4 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ăn @resource/resource_food.webp@

1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@từ @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ sang xây @abilities/repair.webp@@building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@@resource/rally.webp@ sau đó quay lại@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@

sau khi lên đời chuyển 5  @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ xây@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ sang ăn @resource/sheep.webp@ và 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ sang ăn@building_economy/farm.webp@

rút 10  @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ đang@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ sang@abilities/repair.webp@ xây nhà chính 2°@building_economy/town-center.webp@ đặt cạnh bãi vàng@resource/resource_gold.webp@ nếu mỏ vàng nguy hiểm đặt cạnh @resource/berrybush.webp@+@resource/resource_wood.webp@ ou @resource/deer.webp@

@age/age_3.webp@ vừa ra quân def - công vừa lên đời 3

sau khi được 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ chuyển 5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ăn @resource/resource_stone.webp@ sang ăn @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ cạnh  @building_economy/town-center.webp@

5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ăn @resource/sheep.webp@ chuyển sang @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ còn lại @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ chừa 4 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ăn @resource/resource_food.webp@

1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@từ @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ sang xây @abilities/repair.webp@@building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@@resource/rally.webp@ sau đó quay lại@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@

sau khi lên đời chuyển 5  @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ xây@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ sang ăn @resource/sheep.webp@ và 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ sang ăn@building_economy/farm.webp@

rút 10  @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ đang@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ sang@abilities/repair.webp@ xây nhà chính 2°@building_economy/town-center.webp@ đặt cạnh bãi vàng@resource/resource_gold.webp@ nếu mỏ vàng nguy hiểm đặt cạnh @resource/berrybush.webp@+@resource/resource_wood.webp@ ou @resource/deer.webp@

sau khi xây xong TC 2@building_economy/town-center.webp@ 5 đi xây @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@@building_japanese/forge-1.webp@tại@resource/resource_gold.webp@ và 5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@

description: From Valdy's video "How To Play Japanese In 2026 | AoE4", link below.
name: Fast Castle
author: BMB

notes: Send 2 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ near @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Then @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@
When enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ send @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to build @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@
When @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ done send all @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Send 3 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ for a full @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and queue @resource/sheep.webp@
When opponent ages up bring back @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to babysit @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@ on @building_defensive/stone-wall-tower.webp@. If threat @technology_defensive/fortify-outpost.webp@ but else do @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@

Use 7 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from  @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ to build @building_military/stable.webp@ and @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@. Hunt @resource/relics.webp@

description: Good in every matchup except english/house of lancaster (villagers with bow), Rus (don't need gold but can maybe burn hunting cabins) and mongols (can outproduce spearmen)
name: Agro into mounted samurai
author: Piepet

notes: @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ + @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@. Try not to block @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ by @abilities/repair.webp@ near @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.
Produce 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to harass ennemy gold without overcomitting
Send 9 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@. The goal is to be greedy and save @resource/sheep.webp@ for safe later food source.

@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ with only 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@, send @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@

When 3 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@ and shift click @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@ (they just need to cut 1 tree to then @abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@)

@unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ ennemy and if danger is high then @technology_defensive/fortify-outpost.webp@. If not, save @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to get @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@ later.
Send the @age/age_2.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to use first @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@ but pay attention to ennemy raids.

@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ witth 7 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ and start collecting @resource/resource_wood.webp@ next to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@.
Try to get a 2:1 ration on @resource/resource_food.webp@ / @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to constantly produce @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ + @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

First @unit_japanese/shinto-priest-3.webp@ place @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@ in the @building_military/stable.webp@ and then go grab @resource/relics.webp@. If can easily grab @resource/relics.webp@, put 3 more @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_japanese/shinto-shrine-3.webp@.

description:
A defensive Japanese Fast 2 TC build using Daimyo Manor before aging up.
Four starting villagers gather one full load of Gold each, move directly to Stone, build a Forge, and then mine Stone. Two additional villagers join Stone

Once Daimyo Manor has been researched and 300 ::Stone remains available for the second ::TC, all six stone miners build the Kura Storehouse. This preserves the main ::Sheep economy for the 400 ::Food age-up requirement.

Theoretical targets
Daimyo Manor completed around 2:20
Feudal age-up started around 3:08
Feudal Age reached around 3:52
Second ::TC started around 3:58

Timings depend on the distance between ::Gold, ::Stone, ::Sheep, ::Wood and the second ::TC location. Follow the resource triggers when they differ from the timestamps.
name: Daimyo Fast 2 TC [WIP]
author: Kinoss

notes: Once each of the four (4*) @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ carries a full load, send all four directly from @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ near @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and start mining @resource/resource_stone.webp@
Do not return them to the @building_economy/town-center.webp@!
This becomes the sixth (6*) @resource/resource_stone.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ miner and the sixth (6*) future @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ builder.
Put the 7 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@in another control group.
Once you hit 175 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, queue the @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@ at the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to queue it right after the current villager.

1* @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ drop current @resource/resource_stone.webp@ at @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ near @resource/resource_stone.webp@ then to @resource/resource_stone.webp@

Once 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ remains available after paying for @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@, using @resource/resource_stone.webp@ control group, remove all 6* @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/resource_stone.webp@
Gather @resource/resource_wood.webp@ line close to the planned @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@

Use @resource/resource_stone.webp@ control group (6* @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@) to @abilities/repair.webp@ @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ near @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and Gather @resource/resource_wood.webp@ after building
Add last producing villager to @resource/resource_food.webp@ Control group (so 8 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ total in @resource/resource_food.webp@ control group)

Move eight @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ (@resource/resource_food.webp@ control group) toward the planned @building_economy/town-center.webp@ second  location near @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Press Drop Off command after move command.

As soon as you have: 400 @resource/resource_wood.webp@; 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@; build the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with 8 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@. Then Gather @resource/resource_gold.webp@ after building
